summary:
I swept the registries on 2026-11-15 using the raw Hugging Face API and models-json listings plus the Ollama search HTML (htmx pages 1 to 6 of c=tools). Most of the newest strong models are 27B to 40B, or MoE with 2B to 9B active parameters. At 4-bit their weights are about 15 to 25 GB, so few of them fit fully in 16 GB VRAM under vLLM. Most will need llama.cpp or Ollama with MoE experts kept in system RAM.

On the user's own HF listing (https://huggingface.co/models?num_parameters=min:3B,max:32B&apps=vllm&base_model_relation=base&sort=trending) the top trending model is Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (6.55M downloads, 20,076 likes, created 2026-08-05). openai/gpt-oss-20b, Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B, nvidia Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B, GLM-4.7-Flash, gemma-4-31B/26B-A4B and Qwen3.6-27B also appear on its pages 1 to 3 or in the downloads sort. Uncensored, abliterated and merge derivatives dominate the trending API lists and were excluded.

On Ollama (https://ollama.com/search?c=local and c=tools) the relevant newest entries with the tools and thinking tags are qwen3.8 (27b, 18 GB q4_K_M, 256K), nemotron-3.5-lightning (30b, 19 to 25 GB, 1M), nemotron-3.5-bolt (e4b 7.2 to 7.9 GB), gemma4 (e2b to 31b, 29.2M pulls), qwen3.6, qwen3.5, gpt-oss (20b 14 GB), glm-4.7-flash, laguna-xs-2.1, north-mini-code-1.0, flint, mimo-v2.6, muse-glimmer and lfm2.5.

Best single-GPU vLLM candidates by size: gemma-4-12B-it QAT w4a16 (10.26 GB, https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-4-12B-it-qat-w4a16-ct), gpt-oss-20b MXFP4 (13.76 GB, https://huggingface.co/openai/gpt-oss-20b), the 9B class (Qwen3.5-9B, MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B) and Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B.

The strongest agentic coders need RAM offload on this machine:
- Qwen3.8-27B (self-reported Terminal-Bench 2.1 73.0, SWE-bench Pro 61.7, https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B).
- Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (SWE-bench Verified 73.4, Terminal-Bench 2.0 51.5).
- Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B NVFP4 (21.56 GB).
- Muse-Glimmer-30B (SWE-bench Verified 76.0).
- Flint 40B-A2B (SWE-bench Verified 74.2).

DeepSeek has no open-weight checkpoint near this machine's size in the window. DeepSeek-V4-Flash is 290.9B and V4.1-Flash 763.2B, and its HF org only published eagle3/dflash/dspark draft heads for other models (2026-06-28). The best DeepSeek-branded local option is the older Ollama deepseek-r1 distill set (updated 2025-07-02). OpenAI has published no new gpt-oss weights since 2025-08 apart from gpt-oss-safeguard. The latest vllm/vllm-openai tags on Docker Hub are cu135-nightly and nightly (2026-11-15). The Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B card pins vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0.

Fit estimates below are inferred from weight sizes and are not measured.

facts.claim: Top of the user's filtered listing (3B-32B, apps=vllm, base_model_relation=base, trending) is Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B with 6,547,772 downloads and 20,076 likes. Page 1 also includes openai/gpt-oss-20b, Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct and google/gemma-4-31B. Pages p=1/p=2 add GLM-4.7-Flash, Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B, gemma-4-26B-A4B and Qwen3.6-27B.

By downloads on the same filter: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 6.94M, Qwen3.8-27B 6.55M, gpt-oss-20b 5.59M, Qwen3.6-27B 2.42M, Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B 1.83M, Qwen3.5-27B 1.67M, Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B 1.37M, GLM-4.7-Flash 1.11M, Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B 963K

The trending text-generation and image-text-to-text API lists are dominated by uncensored, abliterated and merge derivatives (heretic, abliterated, GSQ-RCO GGUFs). Vendor models in the top 100 multimodal list: Qwen3.8-27B #1, gemma-4-31B-it #23, Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-74B-A9B-24GB #40, Qwen3.5-9B #41, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B #46, gemma-4-26B-A4B-it #56
Thinking is on by default and can be disabled per request with chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking=false. preserve_thinking is on by default. Native context is 262,144, extensible to ~1M with YaRN.
Self-reported Terminal Bench 2.1 73.0, SWE-bench Pro 61.7, DeepSWE 1.1 42.2 (Claude Code harness, 256K ctx)

74B-A9B-24GB checkpoint is 24.08 GB, 256K context, vLLM uses --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder and a plugin reasoning parser ultra_v3
Gemma 4 sizes E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B A4B, 31B; 128K context on small models and 256K on 12B/26B/31B; configurable thinking via enable_thinking
google/gemma-4-12B-it-qat-w4a16-ct is 10.26 GB; gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-qat-q4_0-gguf is 14.44 GB plus 1.19 GB mmproj; gemma-4-31B-it-qat-w4a16-ct is 23.27 GB
No new gpt-oss weights after 2025-08-04 except gpt-oss-safeguard-20b/120b (2025-09-18). The gpt-oss-20b MXFP4 original weights are 13.76 GB. Ollama gpt-oss:20b is 14 GB with 128K context.

deepseek-ai has published no full LLM in the 3B-120B range since 2025-11-15. Its only new repos are eagle3/dflash/dspark speculative draft heads (2026-06-28). DeepSeek-V4-Flash is 290.9B and V4.1-Flash is 763.2B.
Ollama deepseek-r1 (1.5b-671b distills, tools/thinking) was last updated July 2, 2025, so it is older than the window
vllm serve zai-org/GLM-4.7-Flash --tool-call-parser glm47 --reasoning-parser glm45; self-reported SWE-bench Verified 59.2 (vs GPT-OSS-20B 34.0 in same table)

facts.claim: RecursiveSI/flint is a 39.8B MoE (Ollama 40b-a2b) with self-reported 54.9% Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 74.2% SWE-bench Verified, 262,144 context, OpenAI-compatible tool calls

meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B: 30B with perception encoder, 131,072+ context, self-reported SWE-Bench Verified 76.0, TerminalBench 2.1 51.7; same table gives Qwen3.6-27B 77.2/60.7 and Gemma4-31B 66.6/43.4
Always-thinking reasoning model, 24B total / 2B active, 131,072 context, FP8 checkpoint published

Only these vendor checkpoints are at or under ~14 GB of weights and so can run fully in 16 GB VRAM under vLLM: gemma-4-12B-it QAT w4a16 (10.26 GB), gpt-oss-20b (13.76 GB), Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B, and quantized 9B models. The top coding models (Qwen3.8-27B, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Nemotron-3.5-Lightning, GLM-4.7-Flash) are 18-25 GB at 4-bit.
facts.notes: Arithmetic on listed file sizes; KV-cache room not modelled

gaps: The Ollama search pagination needs the HX-Request header. o=popular redirects to /search, so a separate popularity-sorted listing was not available and the default ordering was used.
I did not open the vLLM recipes (recipes.vllm.ai) or docs.vllm.ai, so the parser names come from model cards only. Qwen3.8-27B's tool-call parser is not stated in its README.

I did not extract tool-calling and thinking details for Gemma 4 (vLLM parser names), Qwen3.5-9B, Laguna-XS-2.1, North-Mini-Code-1.0, Ornith-1.5 or MiMo-V2.6. Their Ollama tags show tools/thinking, but I did not confirm this on the cards.
I did not verify that meta-models (Muse Glimmer) and ornith-ai are official vendor orgs.
gpt-oss-20b on-disk size: the HF repo lists both the HF-format shards (~13.76 GB) and original/model.safetensors (13.76 GB); the actual download is one copy.
I did not compute KV-cache headroom from config.json, so every fit_16gb estimate is inferred from weight sizes only.
I found no stable vllm/vllm-openai release tag in the Docker Hub first page (nightlies only). The GitHub releases API was not queried.
Community GGUF quants (unsloth, bartowski, ISTA-DASLab) at IQ3 that might fit Qwen3.8-27B fully in 16 GB were seen but not evaluated.
